battle.name: 糕點戰爭
battle.brief: 一八三八年十一月二十七日，法國分艦隊封鎖墨西哥灣，炮擊聖胡安·德烏魯阿要塞，次日清晨迫其投降；十二月五日法軍再以一千五百人分三路登陸奪取韋拉克魯斯城，俘墨軍總司令阿里斯塔。這場以糕餅糾紛得名、由艦炮決定的戰爭，卡面火繩槍早已退為軍械庫中的舊物。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 交戰的一方是法國七月王朝，另一方是墨西哥中央集權共和國。法國的參戰力量是總理莫萊與海軍部推動的一次海上遠征：一支由少將博丹指揮的分艦隊，旗艦是五十門砲的「涅瑞德」號，主力為四艘巡防艦、兩艘巡洋艦、兩艘砲艦與八艘雙桅巡航艦，另配兩艘汽船與兩艘運載船，全艦火炮總數三百八十門，攜帶三個砲兵連與一個工兵連，卻沒有海軍步兵，地面戰力全靠水手上岸臨時充當。艦隊的後勤基地設在西班牙古巴的哈瓦那，煤與糧食都得自遠方補給。墨西哥方面，韋拉克魯斯市與聖胡安·德烏魯阿要塞由中央政府的守軍與民兵分頭防守，要塞指揮官是將軍曼努埃爾·林孔，市區指揮官是將軍安東尼奧·加奧納；城外的中央軍由阿里斯塔與聖安納率領，兵力約三千二百人，另有威廉·布朗指揮的墨西哥分艦隊與沿岸民兵。英國以駐北美分艦隊與公使帕肯納姆居間調解，美國以一艘小型帆船協助法方封鎖，夾在中間的德克薩斯共和國則派出一個營沿科珀斯克里斯蒂灣巡邏攔截走私船。
countriesEn: One side was the July Monarchy of France, the other the Centralist Republic of Mexico. The French force was a naval expedition pushed by the prime minister Molé and the navy department: a squadron under Rear Admiral Baudin, its flagship the fifty-gun frigate Néréide, built around four frigates, two corvettes, two bomb ketches and eight brigs, with two steamers and two storeships; the squadron carried 380 guns in all and transported three artillery companies and one engineering company, but it had no naval infantry, so its ground strength was improvised from sailors put ashore. Its logistic base was Havana in Spanish Cuba, and coal and stores had to be fetched from far off. On the Mexican side the city of Veracruz and the citadel of San Juan de Ulúa were held by government troops and militia, the citadel under General Manuel Rincón and the town under General Antonio Gaona; outside the city the government fielded about 3,200 men under Arista and Santa Anna, together with the Mexican squadron under William Brown and the coastal militia. Britain mediated through its North American squadron and the ambassador Pakenham, the United States assisted the French blockade with a small schooner, and the Republic of Texas, caught in between, sent a battalion to patrol Corpus Christi Bay against smuggling.
people: 推動這場戰爭的人可以分成三組。法國方面，國王路易·菲利普在總理莫萊的主張下，於一八三八年向墨西哥提出六十萬比索的索賠要求，隨後授權海軍動手；七十二歲的少將博丹帶領分艦隊越過大西洋，把打擊點選在墨西哥灣最重要的港口，而不是向內陸深入；二十歲的約安維爾親王以「克雷奧勒」號巡洋艦指揮對要塞的轟擊，十二月五日又率中央縱隊登陸奪取港口，憑此役一躍成名，日後成為推動蒸汽動力與新式砲術的倡導者。糾紛的源頭人物是糕餅師勒蒙泰爾：一八三二年他在墨西哥城郊塔庫巴亞的店舖被墨軍士兵洗劫，索賠六萬比索，而那家店本身估值不足一千比索。墨西哥方面，總統布斯塔曼特始終不肯付款；聖安納於一八三八年秋從哈利斯科的莊園復出，自行巡視韋拉克魯斯防務並向政府請纓，十二月五日一役中腿部被法軍霰彈重傷，六日截肢，卻靠著這份傷病聲望捲土重來，一八三九年三月二十日以政變再度掌權；阿里斯塔在突擊中被俘；林孔在要塞內苦撐到彈藥將盡才簽字；加奧納代表守軍交出城堡。英方由公使帕肯納姆率艦調停，最終促成三月九日的和約。
peopleEn: The people who drove this war fall into three groups. On the French side, King Louis-Philippe, acting on the demand of the prime minister Molé, put forward the claim of 600,000 pesos against Mexico in 1838 and then authorised the navy to act; Rear Admiral Baudin, aged seventy-two, led his squadron across the Atlantic and chose to strike the most important port of the Gulf of Mexico rather than push inland; and the twenty-year-old Prince de Joinville commanded the Créole in the bombardment and the central column in the landing on 5 December, became a hero overnight and was afterwards an advocate of steam power and of the new artillery. The origin of the quarrel was a pastry cook, Monsieur Remontel, whose shop in Tacubaya on the outskirts of Mexico City was looted by Mexican soldiers in 1832; he demanded 60,000 pesos for a shop valued at less than a thousand. On the Mexican side, President Bustamante would not pay; Santa Anna came out of retirement on his ranch in Jalisco in the autumn of 1838, surveyed the defences of Veracruz on his own and offered his services to the government, was wounded in the leg by grapeshot on 5 December and had the leg amputated on the sixth, yet turned that wound into political capital and seized power again in the coup of 20 March 1839. Arista was taken prisoner in the assault; Rincón fought on until the ammunition was nearly spent and then signed the capitulation; Gaona handed over the fortress on behalf of the garrison. On the British side the ambassador Pakenham brought a squadron to mediate, and the settlement of 9 March was the result.
kits: 卡面這件火繩槍在一八三八年已是三百多年前的古物，它在體系裡的位置只能從制度而非戰場去理解。十六世紀西班牙大方陣的火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊，方陣以厚度換取彈幕，把這些弱點變成整齊的輪射；十九世紀的線列步兵早已取消方陣，改用線列齊射，火繩槍本身也早被燧發槍與雷管槍取代，墨西哥軍械庫中僅存少量火繩槍作為舊式庫存與教練之用，遠征的實際交火並不涉及它。真正決定這場戰爭的是砲與火藥。聖胡安·德烏魯阿要塞架有一百零三門青銅砲與八十三門鐵砲，其中鐵砲多半是舊式滑膛老炮，守軍有效兵力僅四百至五百人；法方分艦隊全艦火炮三百八十門，包含裝在巡防艦上的新式爆彈重砲，以及拖在後面的兩艘砲艦所載的大口徑重型臼砲。登陸時法軍以水手臨時編成隊伍，配一八三七年式制式滑膛燧發步槍、海軍制式彎刀與斧，艇上另備小口徑短管砲。墨軍一側是燧發與雷管式滑膛步槍配刺刀、四至八磅野戰砲，以及舊式艦載短管砲，軍官則攜帶雷管手槍與彎刀。封鎖期間的補給由法方運載船自哈瓦那運來，煤炭與淡水是艦隊最緊張的物資。
kitsEn: The matchlock on this card was already more than three centuries old in 1838, and its place in the system can be understood from institutions rather than from the battlefield. The matchlock of the sixteenth-century Spanish square had to be lit, aimed and queued, and the square turned those weaknesses into orderly volleys by sheer thickness; nineteenth-century line infantry had long abandoned the square for linear volleys, and the matchlock itself had been replaced by the flintlock and then the percussion cap, so that only a few matchlocks survived in Mexican arsenals as obsolete stores and drill pieces, and the actual fighting of the expedition never involved them. What decided this war was artillery and its ammunition. The citadel of San Juan de Ulúa mounted 103 bronze guns and 83 iron guns, the iron ones for the most part old smoothbore pieces, and its effective garrison was only four to five hundred men; the French squadron carried 380 guns, among them newly introduced shell guns on the frigates and the heavy mortars mounted on the two bomb ketches towed astern. For the landing, the French improvised landing parties from the crews, armed with the regulation smoothbore flintlock musket of the 1837 pattern, naval sabres and axes, with small short-barreled guns in the boats. On the Mexican side were flintlock and percussion smoothbore muskets with bayonets, four- to eight-pounder field guns and old naval carronades, with percussion pistols and sabres carried by the officers. During the blockade the squadron drew its stores from the storeships out of Havana, and coal and fresh water were the most awkward items it had to keep up.
tactics: 法方的戰法全部圍繞海權展開。博丹選擇韋拉克魯斯，因為它是墨西哥灣最重要的港口，而墨西哥沒有能與之分量的主力艦。分艦隊先以縱隊駛近，把兩艘砲艦拖到礁石後方，十一月二十七日下午兩點半三艘巡防艦同時開火，兩艘砲艦跟進投射重彈；墨軍兩個火藥庫被擊中爆炸，號誌塔在煙火中崩塌，砲火很快稀疏下去，當日二十點法方停火以節省彈藥，守軍當夜陣亡逾二百二十人、存藥幾近耗盡，二十八日凌晨三時要塞簽字投降。登陸突擊則是一次精準的奇襲：十二月五日凌晨五點，一千五百人自三處灘頭上岸分成三路，兩翼攀上聖地亞哥與康塞普西翁的城牆，破壞砲位，中央縱隊在約安維爾率領下炸開通往港口的城門，奪取墨軍司令部所在房屋，阿里斯塔被俘；撤退時墨軍反擊，法軍用奪得的舊砲與艇上短管砲打霰彈收場，聖安納在亂軍中墜馬重傷。整體看，這是一場以封鎖、炮擊與奇襲為主的短促海陸戰，沒有一次正面會戰，勝負全由艦炮的射程、射速與投射藥決定。
tacticsEn: The French method turned entirely on sea power. Baudin chose Veracruz because it was the most important port of the Gulf and Mexico had no fleet able to contest it. The squadron closed in line ahead, towing the two bomb ketches in behind the reef; at half past two in the afternoon of 27 November three frigates opened fire and the bomb ketches followed with their heavy shells. Two of the Mexican powder magazines exploded, the signal tower went up in a mushroom of smoke and debris, and the fire from the fort slackened; at eight in the evening Baudin called a cease-fire to save ammunition, and the defenders had already lost more than 220 men that night and had fired away nearly all their powder. At three in the morning of the 28th the fort capitulated. The landing was a precise surprise: at five in the morning of 5 December fifteen hundred men came ashore at three beaches and split into three columns, the two wings climbing the walls near the strongholds of Santiago and Concepción and disabling the guns there, while the central column under Joinville blew open the gate that commanded the approach to the harbour, stormed the town and took the buildings where the Mexican generals were thought to be, capturing Arista. On the way back the Mexicans counter-attacked, and the French brought the fight off with grapeshot from the captured guns and the boat carronades; Santa Anna's horse was killed under him and he was severely wounded. Taken as a whole this was a short naval and amphibious war of blockade, bombardment and surprise, with no set-piece engagement, and its outcome was settled by the range, rate of fire and projectile of the naval guns.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰事自一八三八年十一月二十七日延至一八三九年三月九日，全程約三個月又十二天。法國出動二十六艘船，兵力三千至四千人，全艦火炮三百八十門，攜三個砲兵連與一個工兵連而無海軍步兵；墨方唯一能與之抗衡的海上力量是威廉·布朗的墨西哥分艦隊，其主力在法軍於一八三八年十月佔領馬丁·加西亞島後已被解除武裝。聖胡安·德烏魯阿要塞守軍有效兵力四百至五百人，架青銅砲一百零三門、鐵砲八十三門。十一月二十七日炮擊中法軍陣亡四人、負傷二十九人，墨軍陣亡逾二百二十人；十二月五日登陸一役法軍陣亡八人、負傷五十六人，多數為己方誤擊，墨軍陣亡三十一、負傷二十六人。各方統計口徑不同，另有法軍傷亡一百二十一、墨軍傷亡二百二十四並喪失一座要塞的說法。索賠金額為六十萬比索，折三百萬法郎。分艦隊於一八三九年八月十五日返抵布雷斯特港，途中因黃熱病失去二十四人；一八三七年先行抵達的第一支分隊曾無阻攔地封鎖港口並扣留三十六艘商船。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war ran from 27 November 1838 to 9 March 1839, about three months and twelve days. France put twenty-six ships into it with three to four thousand men, 380 guns in all, three artillery companies and one engineering company, and no naval infantry; the only Mexican force able to contest the sea was the squadron under William Brown, whose vessels had been disarmed after the French occupied Martín García Island in October 1838. The effective garrison of San Juan de Ulúa was four to five hundred men behind 103 bronze guns and 83 iron guns. In the bombardment of 27 November the French lost four killed and 29 wounded and the Mexicans more than 220 killed; in the landing of 5 December the French lost eight killed and 56 wounded, most of them from friendly fire, while the Mexicans lost 31 killed and 26 wounded. The accounts differ, and figures of 121 casualties for the French and 224 for the Mexicans with one fortress lost are also given. The indemnity claimed was 600,000 pesos, equal to three million francs. The squadron returned to Brest on 15 August 1839 after losing twenty-four men to yellow fever; an earlier squadron that arrived in 1837 had blockaded the port unopposed and seized thirty-six merchantmen.
cause: 打起來的原因分遠因與近因兩層。遠因是墨西哥革命與獨立之後的亂局：中央政府無力維持秩序，暴動、劫掠與私刑時有發生，外國商民既無代表也無求償管道，只能回本國求援；法國與墨西哥雖在墨西哥獨立初期已有商業往來，但法國一直沒有拿到像美國與英國那樣的貿易協定，法貨關稅偏重，法國商人自一八二八年巴里安市場法商被劫之後屢有蒙冤。直接導火線是一八三二年發生在墨西哥城郊塔庫巴亞的糕餅店事件：糕餅師勒蒙泰爾的店被墨軍士兵洗劫，他索賠六萬比索，而店舖估值不足一千比索；事件經法國王室遞交照會，又加上法籍公民被處決等案例，總理莫萊於一八三八年把要求合併為六十萬比索，並要求墨方懲兇、保護未來法僑、免除法商戰時徵用與借款。墨方總統布斯塔曼特既無力立即籌款，也不願承認外國對本國軍隊的指控，一八三八年四月十六日雙方斷交，談判宣告破裂，一八三七年先行抵達的「埃爾米妮」號分隊曾無阻攔地封鎖港口並扣留三十六艘商船，最後只剩開火一途。
causeEn: There were a distant cause and a proximate one. The distant cause was the disorder that followed the Mexican revolution and independence: the central government could not keep order, riots, looting and summary punishment were recurring, and foreign merchants had neither representatives nor a channel for compensation, so they turned to their own governments. France traded with Mexico in the early years of the new republic, but had never obtained the sort of trade agreement enjoyed by the United States and Britain, French goods were taxed more heavily, and French traders had been at a loss since the looting of French shops at the Parian market in 1828. The proximate spark was the pastry-shop incident at Tacubaya on the outskirts of Mexico City in 1832: the shop of the pastry cook Remontel was looted by Mexican soldiers, and he demanded 60,000 pesos for a shop valued at less than a thousand. His case was passed up through the French embassy and joined with others, such as the execution of a French citizen, until in 1838 the prime minister Molé merged the claims into a demand for 600,000 pesos, together with punishment of the culprits, guarantees for French interests in future, and exemption of French traders from war levies and forced loans. President Bustamante could neither pay at once nor accept the foreign accusation against his own soldiers; on 16 April 1838 relations broke off, and the first squadron, which had arrived in 1837, had already blockaded the port unopposed and seized thirty-six merchantmen. Only the opening of fire was left.
impact: 後果遠超一場小衝突的份量。技術上，聖胡安·德烏魯阿在不到一天內被新式爆彈重砲與臼砲攻破，讓各國軍事觀察家重新評價海岸防禦的價值，普遍認為舊式城牆與滑膛砲已難抵擋爆彈，這次交火被視為各國海軍改裝新砲的起點；兩艘汽船在炮擊中拖帶受傷的巡防艦離場，也讓蒸汽動力在戰場上的價值被看見。政治上，墨西哥全國震動，首都一度驅逐境內法國公民，中央政府的威信受損，聖安納因在突擊中受傷反而成為全國的英雄，傷腿以國葬待遇安葬，其聲望最終把他送回權力中心，一八三九年三月二十日的政變即是這場戰爭在墨西哥留下的政治結果，而墨西哥此後十年間的中央集權與對外關係反覆，也都以這場戰爭為起點。經濟上，六十萬比索的賠款從未真正付清，這筆舊帳在一八六一年成為法國第二次干涉墨西哥的理由之一；法國商人此後獲得人身與財產的正式保護，兩國貿易也取得新的安排，墨西哥還因此向法國敞開了新的通商口岸。
impactEn: The consequences reached far beyond the size of the quarrel. Technically, San Juan de Ulúa fell in under a day to new shell guns and heavy mortars, and military observers across Europe revalued coastal defence, judging that old walls and smoothbore guns could no longer stand against exploding shells; the engagement is commonly taken as the starting point of the rearming of navies with shell artillery. The two steamers towing damaged frigates off the reef also showed what steam could do on a battlefield. Politically, Mexico was shaken to its foundations, French residents were expelled from the capital for a time, the authority of the central government suffered, and Santa Anna became a national hero precisely because he was wounded in the assault; his leg was buried with full military honours, and that reputation eventually carried him back to power in the coup of 20 March 1839, while the centralisation and the shifting foreign policy of the following decade both grew out of this war. Economically, the 600,000 pesos were never actually paid, and that unpaid debt became one of the pretexts for the French intervention of 1861; French residents gained formal protection of person and property, and the two states reached new trading arrangements that opened new Mexican ports to French trade.
result: 結果是法國在軍事與外交上雙贏。十一月二十七日要塞投降，十二月五日法軍攻入韋拉克魯斯城，墨西哥政府隨即向法國宣戰並驅逐境內法國公民，韋拉克魯斯守軍一度撤出城區，但法軍兵力有限，無法長期占城，實際掌握的是海上的要塞與制海權。封鎖切斷了墨西哥灣的貿易，缺口只能靠德克薩斯的科珀斯克里斯蒂口岸與布拉沃河一帶的走私填補，德克薩斯方面還派兵巡邏灣口攔截走私船，故事中遺下「麵粉崖」的地名。英國以駐北美分艦隊與公使帕肯納姆的調停下促成談判，一八三九年三月九日簽訂和約：墨西哥承諾支付六十萬比索，法國得到未來貿易上的便利與對本國僑民的保護，分艦隊其後於八月十五日返航。墨方的損失集中在兩名高級將領被俘與聖安納重傷致殘，日後他在政變中重新掌權，把這場戰爭變成自己的政治資本；法國則以一位海軍英雄與一次艦炮技術示範收場，同時也把一條通往墨西哥的干預之路留了下來。
resultEn: The result was a double French victory, military and diplomatic. The fortress capitulated on 27 November; the French took the city of Veracruz on 5 December; the Mexican government declared war on France and expelled French residents from the country; the garrison withdrew from the city for a time, but with so few troops Baudin could not occupy it permanently, and what France actually held was the fortress offshore and command of the sea. The blockade cut the trade of the Gulf, and the gap could only be filled by smuggling through Corpus Christi in Texas and the country along the Rio Bravo, with Texan troops policing the bay mouth against the runners, which is how the place name Flour Bluff survives in the story. British mediation by the North American squadron and the ambassador Pakenham brought the parties to the table, and the settlement of 9 March 1839 provided for 600,000 pesos to be paid, for French commercial advantages and for the protection of French subjects; the squadron sailed home on 15 August. Mexico's losses were concentrated in two senior officers taken prisoner and in Santa Anna's maiming, and he turned the war into his own political capital when he returned to power; France ended the war with a naval hero and a demonstration of naval artillery, and left behind a road that would one day lead French armies into Mexico again.
